create.name: Sarah Janes
create.bio:
Sarah Janes is an English writer, researcher and retreat leader whose subject is dreaming: its history in the ancient world, the temple-sleep rites of Greece and Egypt, and how people today can work with dreams. A lucid dreamer from childhood, she researches the oracles, sanctuaries and mystery religions of antiquity, and has joined Rupert Sheldrake and the British Pilgrimage Trust in reviving dream incubation at sacred places in Britain. Inner Traditions published her book on the subject, Initiation into Dream Mysteries, in 2022.

She lives mainly in the village of Ancient Epidavros in the Peloponnese, near the old Sanctuary of Asklepios, and also spends time in Istanbul and on the south coast of England. Under the name Dream Mysteries she leads residential dream retreats at Greek sites such as Epidavros, Delphi and Elefsina, a training retreat for people who want to use dreamwork with others, online courses and recorded hypnagogic meditations, one-to-one dream sessions and themed walks around the British Museum. In 2023 she was one of the founders of Dream Palace Athens, and she hosts a monthly online panel series, along with the Explorers Egyptology talks, on her YouTube channel.

books.title: Initiation into Dream Mysteries: Drinking from the Pool of Mnemosyne
books.author: Sarah Janes
books.description: Sarah Janes traces how dreaming was understood and practised in the Western esoteric tradition, from ancient temple sleep to the present day. The book mixes history with her own experience and with exercises for lucid and incubated dreaming.

courses.title: Songlines of Sleep: Dream Mysteries Training Retreat
courses.description: A ten-night residential training in Ancient Epidavros for facilitators, artists, teachers and others who want to work with sleep and dreams. The group uses story, myth, ritual, writing, divination and voicework alongside visits to nearby ancient sites.

courses.title: Oracle Dream Retreat 2027
courses.description: Her yearly dream retreat in Greece, visiting oracle and sanctuary sites with guest speakers on magic, psychedelic research and mythic astrology. Days combine site visits, talks and group dreamwork aimed at precognitive and oracular dreaming.

courses.title: Dream Hieroglyphs Full Course
courses.description: Nine recorded two-hour sessions, each on one Egyptian hieroglyph, its sound and its layers of meaning. Includes guided hypnagogic meditations, home exercises and an online group dreamwork space, building towards a personal dreambook.

courses.title: Dream Museum: A Guided Oneiric Odyssey Around the British Museum
courses.description: A four-hour small-group walk through the British Museum in London looking at objects linked to dreams, sleep and the ancient mystery cults. Places are limited to ten, and a guided audio track follows for home practice.

courses.title: Oneiromancy 1:1
courses.description: One-to-one dreamwork sessions in which she helps a dreamer build a closer relationship with their dreams, using her own oneiromantic method. Each process is shaped around the individual's dreams and themes.

courses.title: Hypnagogic Meditation Session for a Divine Dream
courses.description: A recorded guided meditation for the drowsy state before sleep, built around an ancient Egyptian dream image from a scribe's dreambook. The audio file is sent by email after purchase.
